addClaims.text: Unlisted (non-Marketplace) commercially distributed apps get 1 request per minute and at most 15 objects per request on the affected history methods.
addClaims.quote: The new rate limits will be updated to allow 1 request per minute and will return a maximum of 15 objects per request.

addClaims.text: Distributed apps must support SSL (HTTPS) for OAuth redirect URLs and request URLs.
addClaims.quote: Your app must support SSL for all of the following URLs: - OAuth redirect URLs

addClaims.text: Composio manages an OAuth app for Slack: toolkits.get("slack") returns composioManagedAuthSchemes [OAUTH2].

Tested end-to-end: our own Slack app → Composio custom auth config (ac_wdjsafEfFeO8) → Connect Link → connected account ACTIVE → SLACK_FETCH_TEAM_INFO returned the workspace (Composio log log_vWLRLhgETi4L).
Creating a Slack app is instant and needs no review for use in your own workspace; a manifest can set name, redirect URL and scopes in one step.
Slack's Create-app dialog now offers an 'AI agent' template next to 'Starter app', 'From a manifest' and 'Blank app'.
The app's development workspace is chosen at creation and can't be changed later.
With a custom auth config Slack's consent screen reads 'Allow Greenlight test to access Slack' (your app, not Composio's).

Composio's Slack auth config requested about 50 USER-token scopes by default (e.g. chat:write, files:write, search:read.*, users:write) and no bot scopes, so the agent acts as the user. Narrow scopes on the auth config if that's more than you need.
Composio's callback https://backend.composio.dev/api/v3/toolkits/auth/callback works as a Slack redirect URL (HTTPS).

verdict.summary: Unlisted distribution is self-serve in minutes, but unlisted apps created after May 29, 2025 get conversations.history throttled to 1 request/minute; lifting that needs Slack Marketplace approval (10+ active workspaces, up to 10 weeks of review).

replaceScopes.purpose: Read public channel messages (via conversations.history / conversations.replies)
replaceScopes.alternative: Request Marketplace approval if your agent reads history at volume: unlisted apps are limited to 1 request/minute on these methods
Use granular bot scopes; Marketplace review rejects legacy/restricted scopes

replaceScopes.scope: Composio default: ~50 user scopes (calls, channels, chat:write, files, search:read.*, users:write …)
replaceScopes.purpose: What the Slack auth config requested out of the box in our test (user token)
replaceScopes.alternative: Set only the scopes your agent needs on the auth config; prefer bot scopes for workspace apps

addRequirements.label: Marketplace approval to avoid the 1 request/minute history limit
addRequirements.when: Only if your agent reads channel history at volume and the app is distributed outside your own workspace

addUncertainties: Exact scope names for history access depend on conversation type (channels:, groups:, im:, mpim:history); the guide shows channels:history as the common case.

endToEnd.summary: Own Slack app 'Greenlight test' (created from a manifest) → Composio custom auth config → Connect Link → user clicked Allow → SLACK_FETCH_TEAM_INFO succeeded. About 5 minutes of human time (sign-in, Allow).

addRedirectRules.rule: Paste Composio's callback https://backend.composio.dev/api/v3/toolkits/auth/callback under OAuth & Permissions → Redirect URLs (tested).

addArtefacts.title: Slack app manifest (tested)
